comment: Machine-local installs every dev-env machine needs (dev-env#1397). One entry per claude/scripts/register-*.ps1. _machine_installs.py reads this file for dev-env-doctor.py, setup.sh and the daily drift nudge; test_machine_installs.py fails when a register script has no entry. A machine opts out of one with "skip_installs": ["<name>"] in ~/.claude/machine.json.

installs.name: auto-resume
installs.why: reopens sessions a reboot or app crash cut off (ADR-152)

installs.name: docker-watchdog
installs.why: starts Docker Desktop outside the app's process tree and stops it when sessions are done (ADR-158)

installs.name: deploy-approval-notifier
installs.why: shows a toast for each production deploy waiting on your approval (ADR-163)

installs.name: restart-guard
installs.why: asks before a restart and defers Windows Update's restart while Claude sessions are working (ADR-165)
